mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCHING_TBL VALUES (SEQ_MATCH_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{matchingTitle}, #{matchingContent}, DEFAULT, NULL, DEFAULT, #{matchingLocation}, #{matchingDate}, #{matchingLevel}, #{matchingTime}, #{partnerType}, DEFAULT, #{matchingUserCount}, #{activityId}, #{matchingPrice}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT ACTIVITY_NAME, ACTIVITY_ID, USE_YN FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT ACTIVITY_NAME, ACTIVITY_ID, USE_YN FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT M.ACTIVITY_ID, M.MATCHING_NO, M.USER_NO, M.MATCHING_TITLE, M.MATCHING_CONTENT, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT, M.MATCHING_LOCATION, M.MATCHING_DATE, M.MATCHING_LEVEL, M.MATCHING_TIME, M.PARTNER_TYPE, M.MATCHING_TYPE, TO_CHAR(M.MATCHING_PRICE, '999,999,999') AS MATCHING_PRICE, A.ACTIVITY_NAME, U.USER_NICKNAME, M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL A WHERE A.MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO AND A.DELETE_YN = 'N') AS APPLICATION_COUNT,
(SELECT IMG_PATH || '/' || IMG_RENAME FROM USER_PROFILE_IMG_TBL WHERE USER_NO = M.USER_NO AND IMG_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS USER_PROFILE_IMG, CASE -- 1. [마감] 날짜가 지났을 경우 WHEN TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '마감'
-- 2. [마감] 오늘 날짜지만 시간이 지났을 경우 WHEN M.MATCHING_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND M.MATCHING_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') THEN '마감'
-- 3. [마감] 신청 인원이 모집 인원과 같거나 많을 경우 WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO AND DELETE_YN = 'N') >= M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT THEN '마감'
-- 4. [마감임박] (날짜가 2일 이내) AND (남은 자리가 2자리 이하) WHEN (TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 2) OR (M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) <= 2) THEN '마감임박'
-- 5. [모집중] 그 외 나머지 ELSE '모집중' END AS MATCHING_STATUS
FROM MATCHING_TBL M JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL A ON M.ACTIVITY_ID = A.ACTIVITY_ID JOIN USER_TBL U ON M.USER_NO = U.USER_NO
WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND M.DELETE_YN = #{deleteYn}
AND M.DELETE_YN = 'N'
AND M.MATCHING_TYPE = 'NOMAL'
AND M.MATCHING_LOCATION = #{location}
AND M.MATCHING_TIME BETWEEN '07:00' AND '12:00'
AND M.MATCHING_TIME BETWEEN '13:00' AND '17:00'
AND M.MATCHING_TIME BETWEEN '18:00' AND '23:00'
AND M.MATCHING_LEVEL = #{level}
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN (TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 2) AND (M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) <= 2) AND (M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO)) THEN 1
WHEN TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 3 WHEN M.MATCHING_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND M.MATCHING_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) >= M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT THEN 3
ELSE 2 END ASC,
M.MATCHING_DATE ASC, M.MATCHING_TIME ASC
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT USER_NO FROM MATCHING_TBL WHERE MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL WHERE MATCHING_APPLI_NO = #{loginUserNo} AND MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo} AND DELETE_YN ='N'
mapper.update: UPDATE MATCHING_TBL SET DELETE_YN = 'Y' WHERE MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo}
UPDATE MATCHING_APPLI_TBL SET DELETE_YN = 'Y' WHERE MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo} AND MATCHING_APPLI_NO = ${userNo}
